zh.title: 美國航空窄體機隊升級預計提高優質座位比例至40%
zh.summary: 美國航空推窄體機升級；優質座位佔比提升至40%；增加頭等艙座位
body: 美國航空（American Airlines）計劃展開全機隊窄體客機機艙升級工程。根據報導，該航空公司將透過這項改造計畫，將窄體客機上的優質座位比例從現有的25%提升至40%，相當於優質座位容量大幅成長60%。
這項機艙改造計畫涵蓋美國航空旗下全機隊窄體客機。升級內容主要包含增加機上的頭等艙（First Class）以及特選經濟艙（Main Cabin Extra）座位數量，藉此提升窄體機隊整體載客結構中的優質座位供給比例。
相關訊息於2026年8月18日由 Simple Flying 報導指出，美國航空此舉旨在透過調整全機隊窄體客機的客艙座椅配置，擴增頭等艙與特選經濟艙的座位總數。

en.title: American Airlines to Increase Narrowbody Premium Seats to 40%
en.summary: American Airlines upgrades narrowbody cabins; premium seat share rises to 40%; adds First Class seating
body: American Airlines will increase the proportion of premium seats on its narrowbody fleet from 25% to 40% of total capacity. The major cabin upgrade represents a 60% boost in premium narrowbody seating capacity for the carrier.

The expansion will be completed through fleetwide cabin retrofits across its narrowbody aircraft. Under the program, American Airlines plans to install additional First Class and Main Cabin Extra seats to enhance its premium seating footprint.
According to details reported on August 18, 2026, by Simple Flying, the fleetwide upgrades aim to restructure narrowbody cabin configurations by expanding both premium class options.
